## `client.configuration`

The server's configuration, read-only.

### `client.configuration.list`

Signature: `client.configuration.list() -> list[ConfiguredSetting]`

List the running server's settings. Needs the ADMIN role.

Returns: `list of ConfiguredSetting`. One entry per setting, in the settings reference's order. A secret has no value: ``value`` is ``None`` and ``has_value`` says whether it is set.

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.PermissionDenied` | If you do not hold the ADMIN role on the instance with a personal credential. |
